protocol.scope: Typed no-refit MEHLISSA mapping, cross-engine reproduction, structural-sensitivity audit, population and uncertainty decision, and bounded close-out review for the selected Kallenberger 2014 minimal average-cell family.
protocol.pre_protocol_development_runs_role: Feasibility and test-development only; no generated development trajectory is a qualification result. The first authoritative archive is generated after this protocol commit.

implementation.separation_rule: The public adapter locks source identity, stimulus and unresolved units. The source-equation mechanism is a separate class and parameter variation is available only to the explicit qualification runner.

cross_engine_acceptance.deterministic_replay: byte-identical canonical CSV for the same binary, case and settings
cross_engine_acceptance.initial_state: exact equality to the frozen source vector at model_time zero
cross_engine_acceptance.invariants: all nine source-derived invariants remain within 1e-8 absolute residual
cross_engine_acceptance.nonnegativity: all state values remain at least -1e-10

structural_sensitivity.purpose: Same-publication mechanism-structure audit only; not independent validation and not an M5 runtime variant.

population_and_uncertainty.ensemble_import_precondition: A reusable row-level initial-protein distribution with correlation structure and a documented reuse basis must be available.
population_and_uncertainty.reason: The audited public package does not provide a reusable row-level ensemble distribution and correlation structure. Inventing independent marginals would fabricate biological population evidence.

local_sensitivity.purpose: Numerical and model-behavior diagnostic, not a population distribution or uncertainty probability.
local_sensitivity.stability_rule: For endpoints with non-negligible sensitivity, the 1% and 0.5% normalized central sensitivities must agree within 5%; zero-scale endpoints are reported, not divided.

review_and_claim_policy.allowed_if_unblocked_computational_gates: MEHLISSA contains a typed, no-refit reimplementation of the selected Kallenberger minimal average-cell SBML mechanism whose trajectories reproduce the independently generated COPASI reference within the frozen numerical limits.
forbidden_claims: reproduction of the publication population ensemble
biological qualification or prediction for an individual cell
organ, patient, diagnostic, treatment, safety, or clinical validity
treating the 525/526 pair as an independent evidence source
review_and_claim_policy.completion_rule: BCQ-1 may close with explicit BLOCKED findings. It may not label the variant biologically qualified unless publication alignment, reusable population evidence, and external human review are all available and passed.

result_archive.non_overwriting_run_id: UTC timestamp plus protocol SHA-256 prefix
result_archive.failure_retention: Every started authoritative run and failed gate receives a non-overwriting archive and remains visible.

negative_controls: invented SI or nanomolar unit label
changed source parameter through the public adapter
broken source invariant or material negative state
biological or clinical overclaim without blocked gates
next_action: Commit this protocol before generating the first authoritative BCQ-1.4-1.7 archive.
